# Genesis Apocryphon Column 9 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Genesis Apocryphon Column 9 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 9:4 — "fountains of the great deep" vs "deep underground springs"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the fountains-of the-great-deep" | Literal ma'ayanot tehoma rabba |
| LOGOS | "the fountains of the great deep" | Standard formal rendering |
| PNEUMA | "the deep underground springs" | Dynamic modernization |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the fountains of the great deep." The phrase is a fixed biblical expression (Gen 7:11); PNEUMA's modernization loses the cosmological resonance.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 9:5 — "windows of heaven" vs "heaven's floodgates"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the windows-of heaven" | Literal arubbot shemayya |
| LOGOS | "the windows of heaven" | Standard formal |
| PNEUMA | "heaven's floodgates" | Dynamic interpretation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the windows of heaven." Another fixed biblical expression (Gen 7:11); PNEUMA's "floodgates" is interpretive.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 9:6 — "prevailed" vs "surged"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the waters prevailed" | Literal gaveru |
| LOGOS | "the waters prevailed" | Standard formal |
| PNEUMA | "the waters surged" | Dynamic with physical imagery |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "the waters prevailed." Standard biblical vocabulary (Gen 7:18); PNEUMA's "surged" loses the juridical overtone of triumph.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 9:7 — "all flesh perished" vs "every living creature was destroyed"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "all flesh [...] perished" | Literal kol bisra |
| LOGOS | "all flesh [...] perished" | Standard formal |
| PNEUMA | "every living creature [...] was destroyed" | Dynamic paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "all flesh [...] perished." "All flesh" is a Semitic idiom that should be preserved; PNEUMA's paraphrase dissolves it.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements: 4*
*Resolution: LOGOS 2, EMET/LOGOS 2, EMET 0, PNEUMA 0, Compromise 0*
